summary: The current regression evidence shows debug formatting maps control characters to the wrong escape markers across character, string, string_view, and precision-limited presentation. The shared escaping implementation and its boundary behavior are not included, so the repair cause cannot yet be confirmed.
hypotheses: The debug escape writer has incorrect mappings for control characters, causing newline and tab to emit the wrong escape sequences across character and string formatters.
Precision-limited debug string formatting uses the same faulty escape mapping while counting or emitting escaped characters.
